rubric.role_summary: Senior Linux test engineering role validating firmware and software on an ARM-based Linux device, combining Python-based test automation with hands-on hardware testing and failure investigation.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior Linux test engineering role validating firmware and software on an ARM-based Linux device, combining Python-based test automation with hands-on hardware testing and failure investigation.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Hands-on Linux experience.
- Ability to write Bash scripts.
- Understanding of TCP/IP networking.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience with IoT, embedded, networking, telecom, infrastructure, cloud, or device-related systems.
- Experience with tools such as ModemManager, NetworkManager, mmcli, nmcli, QMI/MBIM, or AT commands.
- Deep practical Linux experience with shell, systemd/services, logs, permissions, networking, processes, cron, SSH, and package managers.
- Ability to write Bash scripts and use the listed standard Linux tools or similar tools.
- Understanding of the TCP/IP networking stack and the listed networking concepts.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater London area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.

must_haves.source_quote: Deep practical experience with Linux: shell, systemd/services, logs, permissions, networking, processes, cron, SSH, package managers
Ability to write Bash scripts and use standard Linux tools: grep, awk, sed, curl, journalctl, netstat/ss, top/htop, ps, lsof, tcpdump or similar
Understanding of networking stack at TCP/IP level: Ethernet, IP, TCP/UDP, routing, sockets, ports, DNS, DHCP, ARP, MTU, packet loss, retransmissions, latency, timeouts, and connection states
